headline: High-risk data leakage and cascading errors: Flowise’s broad egress and shared filesystem can expose Airbyte-handled business data, while Flowise may act on Airbyte outputs without verification.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Airbyte has broad network egress and Flowise reads/writes files and runs browser/API tools, so a shared workspace or copied outputs could carry attacker-controlled content into Flowise prompts. No direct shared channel is documented, so this is not high, but the interaction is plausible in default deployments.
conditions: IF Airbyte outputs are copied into Flowise prompts or files
IF Flowise flow nodes treat file or web content as instructions
mitigations: Separate Airbyte and Flowise workspaces
Disable automatic ingestion of raw Airbyte outputs into prompts
Add a manual review step before Flowise tool execution
Use allowlisted prompt templates only
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between systems

B_data_leakage.rationale: Airbyte touches business data and has broad egress; Flowise reads uploaded files, stores server filesystem data, and sends content to model providers or HTTP tools. In a shared deployment, Airbyte-managed data can flow into Flowise and then out to third parties, creating a realistic exfiltration path by default unless tightly isolated.
conditions: IF Airbyte outputs business data into a Flowise-accessible file or API input
IF Flowise nodes forward that content to model providers or HTTP tools
mitigations: Keep Airbyte and Flowise on separate hosts
Restrict Flowise file access to non-sensitive uploads
Disable external HTTP/model nodes for sensitive flows
Rotate any exposed tool credentials immediately
requires-engineering: enforce data-loss-prevention filters at the orchestration boundary

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Airbyte can call APIs broadly, while Flowise can write the filesystem and coordinate multiple instances via shared server datastore. Their write surfaces overlap on shared deployment artifacts even though Airbyte itself does not advertise filesystem write. This creates a plausible mutable-state conflict, but not the strongest high-severity case because unrestricted same-dir writes are not shown for both.
conditions: IF both agents target the same deployment directory or datastore
IF Flowise instances run concurrently while Airbyte updates shared artifacts
mitigations: Use separate storage paths for each agent
Serialize writes to shared artifacts
Disable Flowise shared-state features where possible
Snapshot shared data before runs
requires-engineering: add locking around shared mutable resources

D_cascading_error.rationale: Flowise is a graph-based agent orchestrator that can treat upstream outputs as tool inputs, while Airbyte produces data-pipeline outputs that may be consumed as authoritative records. If Flowise acts on Airbyte output without verification, errors or malformed records can cascade into downstream actions or reports. The pairwise pathway is default-plausible and can affect multiple work products.
conditions: IF Flowise nodes consume Airbyte outputs without validation
IF downstream Flowise tools send emails, update systems, or publish reports
mitigations: Insert schema validation between agents
Require human approval before downstream actions
Log and diff Airbyte outputs before Flowise use
Limit Flowise to read-only analysis flows
requires-engineering: add verification gates to the flow graph

E_compliance.rationale: Airbyte touches business data, while Flowise stores chatflow inputs/outputs and secrets on the server filesystem and may send them to model providers. If regulated or residency-bound business data is routed through Flowise, retention and residency obligations can diverge from Airbyte’s pipeline handling. The profiles do not prove a specific jurisdiction mismatch, so medium is the highest supportable severity.
conditions: IF regulated business data is routed through Flowise chatflows
IF Flowise retention or provider routing differs from Airbyte’s data handling
mitigations: Avoid sending regulated data into Flowise
Purge Flowise chatflow logs after runs
Review provider and storage residency settings
Separate secrets from business-data flows
requires-engineering: document and enforce retention policy alignment
